svg.title: Jobs gained by bicycle with a new cycle path on Avenida Protásio Alves, Porto Alegre
svg.desc: A map of Porto Alegre with the hexagons that gain access to jobs within 20 minutes by bicycle, on low-stress streets, if Avenida Protásio Alves, a radial avenue to the east of the centre, were given a protected cycle path. The gains follow the avenue and the neighbourhoods on both sides of it, from the centre to the eastern edge of the grid. 31% of residents gain; one ride from the east end to the Santa Casa hospital drops from 86.4 to 66.6 minutes, following the avenue instead of side streets.

g.text: Jobs gained within 20 minutes by bicycle on low-stress streets (LTS 1–2; the bicycle is walked
elsewhere) if Avenida Protásio Alves (green, about 7 km) had a protected cycle path. 31% of
residents gain; the average one reaches 31,075 jobs instead of 30,069. The ride drawn takes
86.4 minutes today and 66.6 with the path
A new cycle path on Avenida Protásio Alves, Porto Alegre
